generation.domain: nonsingular real linear system; no exchanges; integer entries

question.:question/problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-2x-2y-2z&=4 \\ 2x+5y-4z&=-19 \\ -x-3y+z&=6\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ 2 & 5 & -4 & -19 \\ -1 & -3 & 1 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 2 & 5 & -4 & -19 \\ -1 & -3 & 1 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & -6 & -15 \\ -1 & -3 & 1 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & -6 & -15 \\ 0 & -2 & 2 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & -2 & 2 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+z&=-2 \\ y-2z&=-5 \\ z&=3\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=3 \\ y&=-5-(-2)(3)=1 \\ x&=-2-(1)(1)-(1)(3)=-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -6,1,3\rangle$.

$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & -2 & 0 & 4 \\ -1 & 2 & 3 & 14 \\ -2 & -1 & -1 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & 3 & 14 \\ -2 & -1 & -1 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & 12 \\ -2 & -1 & -1 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & 12 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y&=-2 \\ y+z&=4 \\ z&=0\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=0 \\ y&=4-(1)(0)=4 \\ x&=-2-(1)(4)-(0)(0)=-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -6,4,0\rangle$.

question.:question/problem:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}2x+2y+4z&=-6 \\ -2x-5y+2z&=-3 \\ 2x+6z&=-6\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}2 & 2 & 4 & -6 \\ -2 & -5 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & 0 & 6 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ -2 & -5 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & 0 & 6 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & -3 & 6 & -9 \\ 2 & 0 & 6 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & -3 & 6 & -9 \\ 0 & -2 & 2 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=-\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 2 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+2z&=-3 \\ y-2z&=3 \\ z&=-3\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-3 \\ y&=3-(-2)(-3)=-3 \\ x&=-3-(1)(-3)-(2)(-3)=6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle 6,-3,-3\rangle$.

question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & -3 & 0 & -6 \\ -2 & -5 & 0 & -10 \\ 2 & 1 & 3 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{3}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ -2 & -5 & 0 & -10 \\ 2 & 1 & 3 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & -6 \\ 2 & 1 & 3 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & -6 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & -11\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=-\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & -11\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -9\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=\frac{1}{3}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right].

$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-3 & 0 & -3 & -12 \\ -2 & -3 & 4 & -26 \\ 1 & -2 & 2 & 1\end{array}\right].

$$

$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & -3 & 6 & -18 \\ 1 & -2 & 2 & 1\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & -3 & 6 & -18 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=-\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 6 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 9\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{3}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right].

$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & 4 & 4 & -8 \\ -1 & 5 & 8 & -28 \\ -2 & 5 & 9 & -28\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ -1 & 5 & 8 & -28 \\ -2 & 5 & 9 & -28\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 & -24 \\ -2 & 5 & 9 & -28\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 & -24 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -20\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -8 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -20\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -12\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=\frac{1}{3}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -4\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y-2z&=4 \\ y+2z&=-8 \\ z&=-4\end{aligned}\right..

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-4 \\ y&=-8-(2)(-4)=0 \\ x&=4-(-2)(0)-(-2)(-4)=-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -4,0,-4\rangle$.

$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}2 & 2 & 2 & 2 \\ -1 & -3 & -5 & -9 \\ -1 & 1 & 5 & 9\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ -1 & -3 & -5 & -9 \\ -1 & 1 & 5 & 9\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & -4 & -8 \\ -1 & 1 & 5 & 9\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & -4 & -8 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 10\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=-\frac{1}{2}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 10\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1\end{array}\right].
$$

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+z&=1 \\ y+2z&=4 \\ z&=1\end{aligned}\right..

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=1 \\ y&=4-(2)(1)=2 \\ x&=1-(1)(2)-(1)(1)=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{3}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ -2 & 3 & -4 & -10 \\ -1 & -1 & -4 & 7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & -12 \\ -1 & -1 & -4 & 7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & -12 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+2z&=-1 \\ y&=-4 \\ z&=-1\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-1 \\ y&=-4-(0)(-1)=-4 \\ x&=-1-(0)(-4)-(2)(-1)=1.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle 1,-4,-1\rangle$.

knowledge_point.title: Solving a 3x3 System of Equations Using Standard Gaussian Elimination

generation.domain: nonsingular real linear system; no exchanges; integer entries

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & 3 & -6 & -3 \\ -2 & -5 & -2 & 8 \\ -1 & 0 & 6 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & 3 & -6 & -3 \\ -2 & -5 & -2 & 8 \\ -1 & 0 & 6 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=\frac{1}{3}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -2 & -1 \\ -2 & -5 & -2 & 8 \\ -1 & 0 & 6 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & -3 & -6 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 6 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & -3 & -6 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 4 & -8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=-\frac{1}{3}R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 4 & -8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y-2z&=-1 \\ y+2z&=-2 \\ z&=-3\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-3 \\ y&=-2-(2)(-3)=4 \\ x&=-1-(1)(4)-(-2)(-3)=-11.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -11,4,-3\rangle$.
